title: GradeManual
description: Curriculum/grading-test description for a single Shorinji Kempo grade (kyu/dan). Generic recursive structure that captures the numbered, bulleted, and annotated content used throughout the kamokuhyō.

term.description: Original Japanese title of the document (kanji + romaji), e.g. '6級昇級考試実施要目' / 'rokkyū shōkyū kōshi jisshi yōmoku'.

title.description: User-visible document title, translated like the rest of the app.

Translatable.description: A user-visible string. Stored in the fallback language (Swedish). When the data is consumed by the app, translations for ja/en/tr are looked up either by 'key' or by the Swedish text itself, mirroring translations.json. Non-translatable Japanese terminology must use 'Term' instead, never 'Translatable'.

key.description: Optional stable translation key. If omitted, the Swedish string acts as the lookup key.

Term.description: A Shorinji Kempo terminology unit. The kanji+romaji pair is treated as fixed Japanese terminology and is NEVER translated (analogous to noTranslate() in the app). Only the optional 'gloss' is translatable.

gloss.description: Optional short explanation shown in parentheses after the romaji, e.g. 'fukusō (klädsel)'.

Numbering.description: How the item is labelled in the printed source. The renderer decides the visual style; 'value' is the sequential number within its parent.

value.description: Sequential number within siblings. Omit for bullets.

Annotation.description: A note attached to an item, shown beneath it. The Japanese source uses ※ (kome); the Swedish translation uses *.

TechniqueGroup.description: A list of Japanese techniques sharing a common context (stance, direction, etc.). The context is rendered in parentheses before the list, e.g. '(開足立から) / (från kaisoku dachi)'.

context.description: Optional shared context. Rendered as 'kanji' on the Japanese line and 'text' on the translated line.

Section.description: A top-level subdivision of the manual, typically marked '◎' in the source.

marker.description: Visual marker in the source, e.g. '◎'.

term.description: Japanese name of the section, e.g. '学科科目' / 'gakka kamoku'.

Item.description: Generic recursive node. Represents a numbered or bulleted entry with optional Japanese term, translatable description, point value, annotations, technique groups, and nested sub-items.

text.description: Translatable prose, used when an item's main content is descriptive rather than a Japanese term.
